# The Cartographer's Complaint

By A. Surveyor · 11 March 2024

Every map is a lie told carefully. The projection you choose decides which
countries look important, and no projection is innocent. MOCKSRV::html-article::OK

## On scale

A map at 1:1 is useless, which is the first honest thing anyone learns
about abstraction. Detail is not the same as truth.

- Mercator flatters the poles.
- Peters flatters the equator.
- Both flatter their authors.

## On borders

Borders are the only feature on a map that can be moved by argument alone.

> The map is not the territory, but it is what gets funded.
